name: adrenaline-orb
effect: Makes wild Pokémon more likely to summon allies. Held: increases the holder’s Speed by one stage when affected by Intimidate.
shortEffect: Makes wild Pokémon more likely to summon allies. Held: increases the holder’s Speed by one stage when affected by Intimidate.

flavorTextEntries.text: Using it makes wild Pokémon more likely to call for help. If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated. It can be used only once.
Using it makes wild Pokémon call for help a number of times. If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated. It can be used only once.
If held by a Pokémon, it boosts Speed when intimidated.
